text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad. I'm writing this letter 
on the train ride back. It was my first 
visit home in a while, and seeing 
everyone's faces made me so happy."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Mifuyu-chan from the village told me. 
When she felt like giving up on her dream, 
seeing me running made her realize she 
couldn't give up either."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"To think that seeing me run... even while 
wrestling with my doubts, could give 
someone strength. I'm so happy. That's 
why... I won't give up either!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna run in a way that lets me be 
proud of myself, and become a 'City Girl' 
that everyone truly loves! And next time, 
I'll start a whole new trend with my own 
two feet!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I'll train hard for the rest 
of the year and challenge the Osaka Hai 
after New Year's! I'll show everyone the 
grit of a Morioka Umamusume!"
